description: Installed-wheel correctness validation for automatic city levels with unchanged population and other inputs. Fixed-level5 cases reproduce the prior release results; automatic cases are solved by both backends.
method: The installed wheel ran outside the checkout with dependency versions matching the lock environment. Each of 70 commanderies was solved at fixed city level5 and automatic city level, using CP-SAT and HiGHS (280 solves). Each received at most10 seconds and4 workers. All fixed results matched the prior release matrix. No population, food, public-order or other scenario inputs were relaxed. These are correctness checks, not speed comparisons.
reproduce: uv run --locked twoptimizer three-kingdoms --commandery all --city-level auto --algorithm cp-sat --algorithm highs --workers 4 --seconds 10

solver.detail: graph_var_lns (d=2.93e-01 s=85 t=0.10 p=0.00 stall=0 h=base)

joint_check_note: Single15-second installed-wheel functional checks at4workers. CP-SAT returned a validated incumbent; HiGHS returned UNKNOWN without an incumbent. UNKNOWN is not an infeasibility proof. These checks do not estimate time to optimality.
